combats.encounter: Living lightning in the tower library

entries.summary: Wins the first action while invisible, initially retreats toward the stairs, then chooses to jump out a window. Casts Misty Step during the fall to reduce the drop, ending invisibility. After a poor Dexterity saving throw, takes 13 damage on landing; no final save number or damage type is stated.

Detaches from the wall and pursues Delwath, sensing his sounds but unable to see him precisely through invisibility. During his escape it fires a lightning blast that misses him and strikes the wall harmlessly.
entries.note: The attack occurs as Delwath jumps; the source does not name it as a reaction or state advantage/disadvantage.

ending.summary: Delwath escapes alive and lands outside in a heap. The lightning creature is not defeated.
